candidates.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
candidates.finding: OpenAI describes a systematic process for flagging, investigating, triaging, and disclosing model-misalignment examples across training, evaluation, testing, and deployment. Reports record the observed behavior, severity and external impact, setting, dates, discovery, affected model(s), investigation scope, implications, unresolved questions, and mitigations.
candidates.hilo_adaptation: Use a non-ranking robot incident dossier and triage queue that records discovery, scope, third-party impact, uncertainty, corrective action, and recurrence. Verified incidents can seed regression cases, but incident disclosure cannot change the frozen WANTED estimand or substitute for the safety gate.

candidates.title: Introducing OpenAI Privacy Filter
candidates.finding: OpenAI describes a locally runnable PII-masking model built from a privacy taxonomy, supervised token classification, public and synthetic data, model-assisted annotation plus review, and evaluations that included correcting discovered annotation issues. OpenAI also states the model is one component of privacy-by-design rather than an anonymization or compliance certificate.
candidates.hilo_adaptation: Add a pre-ingest text-privacy gate for transcripts, annotations, logs, and support notes using a versioned PII/secret taxonomy. Keep raw audio/video under separate access controls, measure false negatives on held-out consented samples, and require human review for sensitive cases instead of treating automated masking as anonymization.

candidates.title: Helix 2.5: Zero-Shot 30-Home Generalization
candidates.finding: Figure reports evaluation of three long-horizon behaviors in 30 unseen Bay Area homes with no data collection, fine-tuning, or adaptation in those evaluation homes, and reports an ablation in which Index pretraining increased zero-shot success from 9% to 56% while task-specific data, architecture, training, and evaluation were held fixed.
candidates.hilo_adaptation: Add a preregistered held-out-site generalization profile that freezes unseen environments before evaluation and reports familiar-versus-unseen performance separately. Treat Figure's result as a company-reported reference to replicate independently, never as WANTED resident-hour evidence or certification.

candidates.title: How to Use AI Agents to Prepare 3D Scenes for Simulation
candidates.finding: NVIDIA describes an agentic workflow that converts source 3D scenes into simulation-ready OpenUSD by adding semantics, physics, sensors, collision properties, rendered preflight views, and SimReady validation before handoff to Isaac Sim or Isaac Lab.
candidates.hilo_adaptation: Require a machine-readable digital-twin readiness gate before synthetic stress testing: bind source-scene hashes, generated USD diffs, physics/sensor metadata, validation results, and human-reviewed exceptions. Agent-prepared scenes remain synthetic infrastructure and cannot contribute resident hours.

reviewed_not_admitted.title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
reviewed_not_admitted.reason: The page reports useful scope-safety and computer-use evaluation results, but the public description does not add enough method-construction detail to justify a distinct data-collection source card beyond the existing continuous-evaluation and misalignment-reporting methods.
